whatItIs: catalyst is an open-source project in the compilers and languages category. It is maintained by PennyLaneAI and primarily looks like a Python codebase. A JIT compiler for hybrid quantum programs in PennyLane

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches compilers and languages workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes:

Catalyst is an experimental package that enables just-in-time (JIT) compilation of hybrid quantum-classical programs.
whoItsFor: Developers who want to understand the representations and compilers that sit between high-level code and runnable circuits.
whatYouCanBuild: Compare IRs, DSLs, transpilers, and compiler assumptions across ecosystems.
Understand how high-level code becomes something a backend can execute.
